newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Most markets quiet, steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Most markets quiet, steady.

text.p: Most millfeed markets were quiet and prices steady Friday with flour mills reluctant to cut prices ahead of the Memorial Day weekend when production should decrease, U.S. millfeed dealers said.
Weekly flour mill runs range from five to seven days, but may drop back one to two days during the holiday, dealers said.
Minneapolis dealers reported strong demand there with a few trades up $1.00 at $66.00 per ton for prompt shipment. They said feed mixers appear to be securing supplies before the holiday.
Kansas City sources said the rail market was quiet with prices mostly unchanged.
Texas sources said that market turned sharply slower this week after being active early in the week.
